verdict.rationale: Teller is a hosted banking API, so publishing its source under an open license is a fair question, but nothing in the evidence shows its core source is published or under an open license. The only GitHub item is a React integration component for Teller Connect, with no license stated. That is a client building block, not the product's source, and a community comment wishes the product 'were just open source', which suggests it is not.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
